name: Eslohe (Sauerland, Germany)
description: Hanging banner of white with narrow blue stripes along both edges, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Eslohe (Sauerland).
history: Municipal flag of Eslohe (Sauerland); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Eslohe arms — parted white and black with a blue figure
